title: OLEANDER Facade / Building Envelope Engineering Process v1.0
purpose: Run bounded professional facade/building-envelope development from authority, exposure and performance basis through system strategy, building physics, loads and movement, fire interfaces, project details, representative testing, delivery readback and in-use return while preserving Architecture, Structural, FLS, MEP, statutory, Knowledge and R-F authority boundaries.
scope_in: facade and building-envelope authority, appointment, exposure and performance basis
facade/envelope system zoning and typology selection
thermal, air, water, moisture, solar/daylight and acoustic envelope interfaces
wind, self-weight, seismic and movement support interfaces
facade fire, cavity, perimeter and opening interfaces
critical junctions, joints, drainage, membranes, sealants, gaskets and tolerances
representative mock-up and performance testing where required
fabrication, installation, QA, field testing and deviation readback
handover, maintenance, defects and in-use change
scope_out: automatic Architecture Design KEEP or aesthetic authority
automatic Structural Engineering or Fire/Life Safety approval
automatic MEP, acoustic or statutory approval outside appointment
automatic project suitability from component or manufacturer data
automatic installed-building truth from analysis or mock-up
automatic Design KEEP or Project Promotion
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Architecture Map v2.1, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Shared Design Quality, R-F Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project jurisdiction, appointment, responsible facade/envelope professionals and applicable statutory/licensed authorities.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on facade/building-envelope performance, system selection, thermal/air/water/moisture behavior, structural support/movement, facade fire interfaces, critical envelope details, testing, fabrication/site quality or in-use envelope condition.
design_question_types: thermal, air, water and moisture control
responsibility_triggers: facade/envelope performance controls project geometry or system selection
component-to-system transfer requires project-specific engineering evidence
structure, MEP, FLS, Architecture or FM interfaces materially affect envelope performance
representative mock-up or field testing is required by project/authority/appointment
fabrication/installation deviation can invalidate the design basis
in-use defect or maintenance evidence contradicts design assumptions
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable valid boundary across authority, appointment, source applicability, exact envelope configuration, professional analysis, interface maturity, representative test transfer, fabrication/site readback and responsible professional/statutory authority governs each envelope claim.
not_triggered_when: a facade image or precedent is referenced without a project envelope-performance claim
a product/material page is catalogued as Knowledge evidence without project design use
mandatory_reopen_triggers: jurisdiction, appointment, design basis or applicable source changes
geometry, orientation, exposure, use or operating-state changes
facade system, glazing, panel, insulation, membrane, sealant, gasket, anchor or firestop substitution
support, movement, tolerance or structural-interface changes
opening, louver, penetration, drainage or control-interface changes
test specimen/configuration, method or acceptance criteria changes
failed mock-up, field test, fabrication inspection or installation readback
in-use leakage, condensation, breakage, movement, fire-interface or maintenance evidence contradicts assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential envelope standards, product/system evidence, manufacturer data, test evidence, building-physics methods, fire/structural interface evidence and project fabrication/site records must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional envelope decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER Professional Domain Process and Design Quality contracts
theory_routes: building physics and envelope control layers
source_routes: applicable project jurisdiction and envelope performance requirements
ISO 12631:2017 curtain-wall thermal transmittance calculation context
ISO 24084:2022 curtain-wall inter-storey displacement resistance test context
Society of Facade Engineering / CIBSE professional guidance and competence context
evidence_routes: project envelope calculations and detail records
representative mock-up and laboratory/site test records
in-use defects, maintenance and observed-performance evidence
standard_code_routes: project-applicable facade, building-physics, structural/loading, fire, energy and product/system standards only after jurisdiction/version applicability review
precedent_case_routes: bounded comparable envelope systems with explicit climate, geometry, configuration, test and transfer limits
practice_routes: envelope performance brief and zone/system strategy
tool_knowledge_routes: thermal, hygrothermal, structural, solar/daylight, acoustic or other simulation only under declared method/version and claim boundaries

stages.professional_question: What envelope claim is in scope, under which authority/appointment basis, environmental exposure and performance brief?
entry_conditions: project and envelope decision object identified
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential authority, exposure and performance-source claims require task/claim-scoped Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Structure, MEP, FLS, Acoustics, FM and Cost triggers identified
human_experience_consequences: thermal comfort, daylight, leakage, noise, operability and maintenance exposure are identified where material
design_language_consequences: architectural appearance remains an input and cannot override performance/authority constraints
technical_consequences: performance categories, source applicability, analyses/tests and claim ceiling are explicit
content_projection_requirements: state appointment, sources, exposure, performance categories and unresolved assumptions
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review required for promotion-relevant adoption.
open_items_allowed: later system detail and testing may remain open if claim stays at performance-basis level
exit_conditions: authority, appointment, exposure, performance brief and claim ceiling are explicit
reopen_triggers: authority, exposure, project use, geometry or performance requirement change

stages.stage_name: System Zoning / Typology / Primary Control Paths
stages.professional_question: Which envelope system families and zones can credibly satisfy the performance brief and project geometry?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential system/predecessor evidence requires Operational Mount with transfer limits.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Structure, MEP, FLS, Interior and FM interfaces represented
human_experience_consequences: views, daylight, comfort, operability and perimeter-use consequences are explicit
design_language_consequences: system module/joint/opening logic is coordinated without converting aesthetic preference into engineering proof
technical_consequences: system zones, primary load/water/air/thermal paths and critical transitions are explicit
content_projection_requirements: system diagrams distinguish engineering assumptions from selected design intent
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required where candidate adoption is promotion-relevant.
open_items_allowed: detailed calculations and exact products may remain open with bounded claim
exit_conditions: system concept and critical transition set are professionally reviewable
reopen_triggers: basis, geometry, system family or adjacent-interface change

stages.stage_name: Thermal / Air / Water / Moisture / Environmental Performance
stages.professional_question: Are declared building-physics functions translated into an internally consistent envelope system with traceable assumptions and failure paths?
entry_conditions: system concept defined for affected zones
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Calculation methods, source values and system evidence require exact-scope Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: MEP, Architecture, Acoustics, Lighting/Daylight and FM assumptions coordinated
human_experience_consequences: comfort, condensation, leakage, daylight/solar and acoustic effects are represented where in claim
design_language_consequences: visible geometry/material choices are tested against control-layer continuity
technical_consequences: method scope/exclusions and junction effects remain explicit
content_projection_requirements: maps show control layers, junctions, assumptions and unresolved risks
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted consequential envelope-physics claims.
open_items_allowed: later physical test or field proof may remain open if clearly outside current claim
exit_conditions: in-claim physics strategy has no unresolved critical internal contradiction
reopen_triggers: layer, product, interior condition, exposure, opening or MEP interface change

stages.professional_question: Can the envelope transfer declared loads and accommodate building/component movement through a traceable support path?
entry_conditions: system concept and structural-interface basis available
required_inputs: system/component properties at current evidence ceiling
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Load, movement, anchor, glass/panel and test evidence requires exact-configuration Operational Mount.
human_experience_consequences: movement-driven leakage, breakage, operability and safety consequences are considered
design_language_consequences: module/joint geometry preserves required movement and support logic
technical_consequences: loads, support, anchor responsibility, drift and tolerance remain distinct and traceable
content_projection_requirements: show load path, support points, movement directions and unresolved engineering items
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant process adoption.
open_items_allowed: main-structure engineering approval remains with Structural owner
exit_conditions: in-claim support/movement strategy is coordinated with no hidden critical conflict
reopen_triggers: load, drift, slab edge, anchor, panel/glass, joint, tolerance or structure change

stages.professional_question: Are triggered facade fire functions represented as complete configuration-specific assemblies and coordinated with FLS authority?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Fire product/system/test/assessment evidence requires exact-configuration Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Fire / Life Safety, Structure, MEP and Architecture fire-interface ownership explicit
human_experience_consequences: life-safety consequences are routed to FLS rather than inferred from material properties
design_language_consequences: visible/hidden envelope composition preserves required fire functions
technical_consequences: material, assembly, assessed/tested configuration and installed condition remain distinct
content_projection_requirements: critical fire interfaces identify exact configuration and authority status
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted envelope process; FLS retains life-safety/statutory review authority.
open_items_allowed: formal FLS/statutory acceptance may remain open and must cap the envelope claim
exit_conditions: in-claim facade fire interfaces are coordinated with FLS ownership explicit
reopen_triggers: assembly, cavity, opening, firestop, slab-edge, penetration or FLS requirement change

stages.stage_name: Critical Junctions / Tolerance / Fabrication / Maintenance Detail
stages.professional_question: Do representative critical details preserve all required control layers, movement, installation and maintenance logic simultaneously?
entry_conditions: system, physics, movement and fire interfaces sufficiently defined
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential product/compatibility/installation evidence requires Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Structure, MEP, FLS, Interior and FM detail interfaces coordinated
human_experience_consequences: threshold, view, comfort, cleaning and replacement impacts are explicit
design_language_consequences: joint/module/material intent is resolved at construction-readable detail level
technical_consequences: control-layer continuity, drainage, fixing, tolerance and sequence are simultaneously readable
content_projection_requirements: critical details remain native/editable and identify unresolved evidence rather than hiding it
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required where detail-process adoption is promotion-relevant.
open_items_allowed: later fabrication/site verification may remain open if design detail claim is bounded
exit_conditions: representative critical details have no unresolved in-claim control-layer contradiction
reopen_triggers: geometry, system, product, support, membrane, sealant, gasket, tolerance or access change

stages.stage_name: Representative Mock-up / Performance Test / Failure Readback
stages.professional_question: Does representative physical test evidence support the exact bounded claim, and are failures/retests traceable?
entry_conditions: testable configuration and acceptance basis defined where testing is required
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Test methods, specimen/product evidence and transfer assumptions require Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: affected Architecture/Structure/FLS/MEP/FM variables frozen or explicitly recorded for the test
human_experience_consequences: visual/operability and leakage-related occupant consequences are included when relevant to mock-up scope
design_language_consequences: visual mock-up approval is separated from engineering performance-test evidence
technical_consequences: specimen identity, modifications, sequence and transfer limits remain traceable
content_projection_requirements: test result presentation distinguishes specimen PASS from project-wide claims
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted process; test laboratory/AHJ authority remains separate where applicable.
open_items_allowed: production and field conformity remain later evidence
exit_conditions: required representative tests have bounded result and failures/retests are traceable
reopen_triggers: specimen, product, detail, test method, acceptance, repair or project-transfer change

stages.stage_name: Submittal / Fabrication / Installation / QA / Field Readback
stages.professional_question: Does delivered work preserve the approved envelope configuration through fabrication and installation with deviations explicitly controlled?
entry_conditions: bounded design/test basis exists for current delivery claim
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential submittal/product/plant/batch/site evidence requires task/claim-scoped Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: contractor/fabricator plus Architecture, Structure, MEP, FLS and FM changes are reconciled through R-F
human_experience_consequences: operability, comfort, leakage, safety and maintenance defects are surfaced
design_language_consequences: fabrication/shop detail change cannot silently alter approved visual/system intent
technical_consequences: submittal identity, QA, deviations, field tests and repairs are configuration-traceable
content_projection_requirements: delivery records distinguish design approval, fabrication QA, installation inspection and field test
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant process adoption; field/statutory acceptance remains separate.
open_items_allowed: unobserved installation areas remain outside evidence and cannot be generalized from samples
exit_conditions: bounded delivery evidence and unresolved deviations are explicit
reopen_triggers: submittal, fabrication, substitution, installation deviation, failed inspection/test or repair change

stages.professional_question: What envelope condition is actually supportable after handover, and what observed evidence reopens the process?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential in-use evidence requires task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before reuse beyond the project.
interface_requirements: FM, Architecture, Structure, MEP, FLS and affected owners receive material in-use change/readback
human_experience_consequences: occupant-reported leakage, condensation, discomfort, noise and operability evidence remains distinct from inferred cause
design_language_consequences: repair/replacement can preserve or intentionally revise design language only with technical compatibility
technical_consequences: observed defect, cause hypothesis, repair and verification are separated
content_projection_requirements: in-use returns distinguish observation, inference, intervention and verified outcome
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant adoption or reusable knowledge transfer, not for every maintenance observation.
open_items_allowed: unknown concealed condition or unobserved areas remain OPEN and cap the claim
exit_conditions: current bounded in-use state and reopen items are explicit
reopen_triggers: defect, incident, repair, replacement, operating change or adjacent-system change

inputs_from_domains: Architecture geometry, appearance, openings and thresholds
Structural supports, slab edges, movement, loads and tolerances
MEP louvers, penetrations, ventilation, drainage and controls
FM cleaning, inspection, access, replacement and maintenance requirements
outputs_to_domains: envelope performance brief and system zones
controlling_authority_requirements: Structural owner retains main-structure/member engineering authority
Architecture owner retains architectural design authority
project jurisdiction and responsible licensed professionals retain statutory/sign-off authority
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Facade/Envelope may declare its required interface maturity but may not self-award R-F interface closure; the controlling Integration owner records actual maturity/disposition.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: open item is outside current claim or later evidence stage
required current interface maturity is already met
open owner and reopen trigger are explicit
integration_readback_requirements: critical shared variables and exact source stage/artifact remain traceable
material envelope change reopens affected R-F interfaces
Envelope process PASS never substitutes for R-F Integration PASS

required_native_outputs: mock-up/test and failure readback where required
fabrication/site QA and deviation records where in claim
handover/in-use return records where in claim
native_source_of_truth_rules: native editable geometry/drawings/calculations/registers outrank generated presentation images
manufacturer imagery or rendered details cannot replace project-native interface definition
test/report identity must resolve to the exact specimen/configuration and method
execution_owner_requirements: named Facade / Building Envelope professional owner for professional decisions
R-F owner for cross-disciplinary interface state
responsible statutory/licensed/AHJ owner where approval is required
required_capabilities: building-physics and movement analysis appropriate to the claim
fabrication/site QA readback where in claim
tool_adapter_requirements: tools must preserve native files/configuration identity and actual readback
AI/generative imagery cannot be used as engineering evidence
simulation/tool outputs must record method/version/input and claim ceiling

assurance.professional_review: Professional review must address performance basis, system concept, critical interfaces, exact configuration, evidence level, open items and claim ceiling; review is not inferred from artifact existence.
assurance.evidence_review: Evidence review must distinguish component, assembly/system, representative test, production, installed and in-use evidence and preserve source/version/configuration applicability.
assurance.independent_review: Independent Professional Domain review is required before promotion-relevant adoption; reviewer competence, authorization and independence must be explicit and producer self-check does not count.
assurance.receipt_contract: A professional receipt may record only the actually reviewed claim ceiling, exact process/inputs/readbacks, open items, verdict and stale/reopen conditions; it does not award other-domain or statutory authority.

reopen_triggers: in-use defect, repair or adjacent-system change
stale_scope_rules: mark only affected stage/evidence/interface scope stale where dependencies can be bounded
propagate stale state downstream when prior assumption/configuration is materially invalidated
do not erase unrelated valid predecessor evidence
upstream_impact_rules: failure or in-use evidence may reopen system choice, performance basis or source assumptions when causally relevant
later evidence cannot silently rewrite historical receipts
downstream_impact_rules: basis/system/detail change propagates to affected tests, fabrication/site QA and in-use records
changed shared variable reopens dependent R-F interfaces
interface_reopen_rules: Envelope cannot self-close reopened R-F interfaces
material change must identify affected source/consumer domains and shared variables
receipt_stale_rules: receipt becomes stale only for the affected claim scope when a bound assumption/configuration/readback is invalidated
superseding receipt must preserve predecessor identity and reason

process_exit_conditions: required native outputs exist for the declared claim ceiling
consequential Knowledge mounts are valid for exact claims
required critical interfaces meet current R-F requirements or remain explicitly outside claim
required analyses/tests/readbacks exist at the declared evidence level
material open items do not contradict the claim
professional review is complete and exact
Independent Review is complete where adoption/promotion requires it
truthful professional receipt exists for a closed process instance
open_items_allowed: later fabrication/site/in-use evidence when outside current design claim
formal statutory approval when explicitly outside the current professional claim
unknown concealed/unobserved field conditions that cap but do not contradict the current evidence claim
completion_contract.professional_receipt: Use the existing professional-domain receipt/control route; receipt must bind exact process definition/instance, inputs, outputs/readbacks, review, verdict, claim ceiling, open items and reopen triggers.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: No automatic promotion. Controlled Evolution requires eligible Independent Review and authorized owner-native adoption under the existing architecture-control route.
